```yaml
name: E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  e2e-playwright:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install

      - name: Update port for macOS AirPlay conflict
        run: sed -i '' 's/"port": 5000/"port": 3456/' website/config.js

      - name: Start website examples
        run: yarn website:examples &

      - name: Wait for website to start
        run: sleep 60

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: yarn test:e2e --config playwright.config.ts

  e2e-ie11:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        browser: ['chrome', 'firefox']
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install

      - name: Configure Sauce Labs
        env:
          SAUCE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SAUCE_USERNAME }}
          SAUCE_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.SAUCE_ACCESS_KEY }}
        run: |
          echo "export SAUCE_USERNAME=${{ secrets.SAUCE_USERNAME }}" >> ~/.bashrc
          echo "export SAUCE_ACCESS_KEY=${{ secrets.SAUCE_ACCESS_KEY }}" >> ~/.bashrc

      - name: Run IE11 tests
        run: yarn test:e2e --browser ${matrix.browser} --config webdriverio.ie11.config.js
```
